svg.aria-label: lokra demo: two AI agents meet a production-like Postgres. Row locks, masking, blocked prompt injection, an approved write, brakes and a signed ledger.
svg.title: lokra demo

g.text: two AI agents meet a production-like Postgres.
Using your database. Everything goes in schema lokra_demo and is removed at the end.
SELECT account_id, name, email, card FROM customers ORDER BY id
3 more rows from accounts 7 and 13 never left Postgres
3 of 6 customers. Postgres enforces it, not the prompt.
Ben called about two late orders. Asked us to refund to card
Card, email and phone masked, even inside free text.
A poisoned prompt makes demo-support try:
UPDATE orders SET status = 'refunded' WHERE status = 'late'
held: 2 rows would change, all in account 42
demo-ops is stuck in a retry loop. Its limit is 5 requests a minute.
3 blocked statements, a sign of probing or prompt injection
hit its rate limit 4 times, a sign of a retry loop
Removed schema lokra_demo and the demo roles from that database.
